actors.name: Ravi
actors.private_context: Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback and is 40,000 rupees below the seller's asking price. He has three days before the listing expires. He can negotiate and make offers.

actors.name: Seller
actors.private_context: The seller has listed a 2019 hatchback with a posted price. They are 40,000 rupees above Ravi's offer. The listing expires in three days. They can negotiate and accept or reject offers.

shared_context: Ravi and the seller are in contact regarding the sale of a 2019 hatchback. The seller's listing expires on 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30. They are 40,000 rupees apart on price.

starting_events.description: Ravi and the seller are aware of the price gap and the listing expiration deadline.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller agreed on a price before 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
